[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Sunjiang District | page name suffix=explorable area | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=256 }} [[Sunjiang District (explorable area)|Sunjiang District]] is a densely-populated suburban area of [[Kaineng City]] that has its southern and western areas infested with the [[Afflicted]]. Where the Afflicted do not wander, the [[Am Fah]] still hold sway. ==Getting there== [[The Count's Daughter]] [[primary quest]] will lead [[character]]s through this area. Exit from [[Zin Ku Corridor]]. Can also be entered from [[Pongmei Valley]] if all [[party]] members have completed [[Tahnnakai Temple]], otherwise the gates of the Sunjiang District [[portal]] in Pongmei Valley will be closed. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with a [[statue]]: *[[Avatar of Dwayna (NPC)|Avatar of Dwayna]] **South-center, overlooking the central lower-ground area. *[[Champion of Balthazar]] **Southwest,
